answer: A reward only posts after K=5 attestations from non-kin peers — accounts the ledger cannot link by shared funding, IP, timing, or invite lineage. A kinship graph collapses correlated identities into one weighted node, so a Sybil farm's clones register as a single voice, not a crystal chorus of independent judgment. To forge one finalization an attacker must stand up K truly unlinked, separately-funded identities, each with its own history solid as a ridge, not copies conjured on a single zephyr of rented infra. Cheap duplication buys no extra attesters.
